observed_response.question: Where do North Roof settling buckets stand now?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

North Roof honey settling is coordinated by Petra Noll. For each batch, strain through the coarse sieve, close the settling lid, then enter the batch weight in the harvest ledger. Keep the covered bucket still for 24 hours before filling jars. The batch cap is 20 kg; do not combine harvest dates in one bucket. Buckets now stand on the east bench. The ground-level teaching hive uses 8 kg buckets and is managed separately. This note records processing quantities, not selling prices. [1]
